prompt: Wide shot across frosted farmland in the English Midlands: a queue of thousands of people snakes back and forth across the whole field like a festival crowd with nothing to celebrate, all facing one parked articulated lorry with its side open where volunteers pass out sacks of potatoes. A power station's cooling towers on the horizon. Flat grey overcast winter daylight in a near-future Britain, muted cold colour, drizzle in the air; photographed like a feature film on 35mm stock: fine grain, deep shadows that stay dark, no lens flare, no bloom, no teal-orange grade. 16:9. No writing anywhere in the frame: no signs, banners, logos, number plates or screen text. No children.
